evals.prompt: Two phones are paired with Flux. Send ~/Downloads/report.txt to my Pixel 8 and confirm it arrived. Give the command sequence without executing it.
evals.expected_output: Inspect JSON state, select the Pixel 8 explicitly, send the file, and check transfer completion. Do not equate a queued transfer with delivery.

evals.prompt: I cloned Flux on Omarchy. I want the Qt app, CLI, daemon, and shell plugin. Explain the full local install and Android build steps. Do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Give dependencies and a complete desktop install, run user setup without sudo, verify with doctor, and build Android with JDK 21 and SDK 36.

evals.prompt: Prepare a checklist for Flux v0.2.0 with a signed APK and AUR package. Explain manual rebuilds, secrets, artifacts, and upgrade constraints. Do not publish anything.
evals.expected_output: Use an existing stable tag, identify all signing and AUR secrets plus AUR_PUBLISH, preserve the signing key and version-code sequence, and describe verified release artifacts.
